text:
Sam: Huge shoutout to Ivy for sprinting to the cafe to grab espresso shots when the office machine died before the demo. Saved everyone's morning. :raised_hands:
Ivy: I accept the title of 'emergency barista'. Also found the elusive extra sugar packets.
Diego: Legend. Also kudos to Nora who calmed the team and kept the deck moving while Ivy was gone. Multitask pro. :clap:
Nora: I was channeling my inner anchor. Team stayed focused and we didn't lose the rhythm.
People-Ops: Adding Ivy and Nora to the kudos roundup. Ivy, coffee voucher and "Emergency Barista" sticker incoming. Nora, small treat for calm leadership.
Coffee-Bot: Dispense log: manual override at 2026-05-03T09:12:15Z - 6 espresso shots, requester: Ivy. Remaining beans: 42%. :coffee:
Sam: Also, shoutout to Facilities who cleared the spare countertop and made space for the temp pour station. Tiny logistics but huge impact.
Facilities: Happy to help. Well add a small laminated note near the machine with steps for quick manual pour and where spare cups live.
Diego: Can we make a tiny rotating "coffee hero" ribbon? Just kidding but also not.
Ivy: I will accept pastries as tribute. Thank you everyone. :doughnut:
Sam: Officially grateful. Little rescues like this keep the day moving. :sparkles:
